$schema_note: AUDIT-10 progress ledger. The FIRST thing a session writes (status=in_progress + date + lock) and the LAST thing it completes (status=complete + deliverable checklist). Committed and pushed on both writes — an unpushed ledger does not exist, because containers are ephemeral. steps_done holds completed step ids from the pass file so an interrupted pass can resume without redoing work.

screenshot_capture.note: screenshots are gitignored and container-local. If a later pass finds _harness/out/audit10/current/ empty (fresh container), it re-runs `node _harness/audit10-crawl.js` first — that is expected, cheap, and MUST be recorded here per re-capture so drift between captures is visible.
